description: This file defines a class GhostStatusBar that manages a VSCode status bar item, including initialization, rendering, updating, and error states, for a Ghost extension or feature within a VSCode environment.

classes.name: GhostStatusBar
classes.description: A class that manages a VSCode status bar item for displaying Ghost extension status, including initialization, rendering, updating, and error handling.

methods.name: getSupportedProviderDisplayNames
methods.description: Returns display names of all supported autocomplete providers based on the PROVIDERS array and AUTOCOMPLETE_PROVIDER_MODELS keys.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the GhostStatusBar instance with provided state props and creates the status bar item.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets initial text and tooltip for the status bar and shows it.

methods.name: createMarkdownTooltip
methods.description: Creates a trusted MarkdownString for tooltips.

methods.name: updateVisible
methods.description: Shows or hides the status bar based on the enabled property.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the status bar item.

methods.name: humanFormatSessionCost
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string of the session cost.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the status bar with new props and re-renders.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a locale time string.

methods.name: renderDefault
methods.description: Renders the default status bar text and tooltip with session info.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Determines which render method to call based on error states or default.

methods.name: renderNoCreditsError
methods.description: Displays a warning when there are no credits.

methods.name: renderNoUsableProviderError
methods.description: Displays a warning when no usable provider is available.
